title: Centralized Growth Management App for multi-brand D2C operations (MVP + architecture/docs)

requirements.text: Implement secure login using Internet Identity and gate all app pages behind authentication.

quotes:
Technical Requirements:
Simple, clean UI
Mobile-friendly
Cloud-based
Secure login
Role-based access

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users are redirected to a sign-in screen and cannot access app pages.
Authenticated users can sign out.
User-facing text is in English.

requirements.text: Implement role-based access control (RBAC) with at least three roles (Admin, Editor, Viewer) and a basic UI for Admins to assign roles to principals.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend enforces permissions for all write operations (e.g., create/update/delete).
Frontend hides/disabled restricted actions based on role.
Admin can assign/change a user’s role and changes take effect without redeploy.

requirements.text: Create the MVP information architecture and UI navigation: a responsive app shell with sidebar (desktop) / bottom navigation or drawer (mobile) and routes for Brands, Dashboard, Marketing, CRO, Products, Operations, Tasks, Reports, Knowledge, and Settings.

quotes: The app should act as my personal Growth & Business Dashboard with the following features: ...

acceptanceCriteria: All listed sections are reachable via navigation.
Layout is mobile-friendly and usable on narrow screens.
Each section has a clear empty state when no data exists.

requirements.text: Brand Management: implement CRUD for brand profiles, including key fields for products/pricing/margins/suppliers/ad budget and weekly/monthly goals, with list + detail pages.

quotes:
1️⃣ Brand Management
Create profiles for each D2C brand
Store key details: products, pricing, margins, suppliers, ads budget
Track monthly/weekly goals

acceptanceCriteria: User can create, view, edit, and archive/delete a brand (subject to RBAC).
Brand detail shows stored key details and goals.
Data persists across refresh/reload.

requirements.text: Performance Dashboard: provide a per-brand and cross-brand dashboard showing KPIs (Revenue, Profit, ROAS, CAC, Conversion rate, AOV, Return rate, Shipping cost) with time-series charts and basic trends over selectable periods (weekly/monthly).

quotes:
2️⃣ Performance Dashboard
Show KPIs:
Revenue
Profit
ROAS
CAC
Conversion rate
AOV
Return rate
Shipping cost
Visual charts and trends

acceptanceCriteria: User can select a brand or view an aggregated overview across brands.
At least one chart per KPI category renders from stored data.
User can switch between weekly and monthly views.
If data is missing, UI explains what to add and where.

requirements.text: Marketing Manager (MVP): implement a module to manually log and review Meta/Google campaign performance (campaign name, platform, spend, revenue, ROAS, dates), compare campaigns, flag underperformers based on configurable thresholds, and store associated creatives/copies as text entries and file links.

quotes:
3️⃣ Marketing Manager
Track Meta Ads & Google Ads performance
Compare campaigns
Suggest budget allocation
Highlight underperforming ads
Store creatives and copies

acceptanceCriteria: User can create/edit campaign performance entries tied to a brand.
User can compare campaigns in a table with sortable columns (at minimum: spend, revenue, ROAS).
Underperforming campaigns are highlighted when they breach thresholds set in Settings.
Creatives/copies can be stored as structured text (e.g., headline/body) plus optional URL references.

requirements.text: Website & CRO Module (MVP): implement a website optimization checklist per brand, an A/B test tracker (hypothesis, variants, dates, result), and a UX feedback notes log.

quotes:
4️⃣ Website & CRO Module
Checklist for website optimization
Conversion improvement suggestions
A/B test tracker
UX feedback notes

acceptanceCriteria: Checklist items can be created, checked/unchecked, and filtered by status.
A/B tests can be created and tracked through statuses (planned/running/completed).
UX feedback notes support timestamps and are searchable within a brand.

requirements.text: Product & Category Manager (MVP): implement SKU tracking per brand (SKU, category, price, cost, margin, inventory), identify best/low-performing SKUs from KPI inputs, and trigger inventory alerts using configurable thresholds.

quotes:
5️⃣ Product & Category Manager
Track best-selling and low-performing SKUs
Inventory alerts
Pricing optimization suggestions
Product profitability analysis

acceptanceCriteria: User can create/edit SKU records per brand.
UI can display a “Top / Low performers” view based on stored sales/profitability fields.
Inventory alert state is shown when inventory <= threshold and can be filtered.

requirements.text: Operations & Shipping (MVP): implement tracking for shipping partners, delivery times, RTO rate, cost per shipment, and an ops issues log per brand.

quotes:
6️⃣ Operations & Shipping
Track delivery time
RTO rate
Shipping partners
Cost per shipment
Ops issues log

acceptanceCriteria: User can log shipping metrics per period and view trends/summary per brand.
Ops issues can be created, assigned a status, and filtered (open/closed).
Key metrics (delivery time, RTO, cost per shipment) appear on the brand’s operations page.

requirements.text: Decision & Strategy Assistant (MVP, non-LLM): generate rule-based recommendations and a weekly action plan using the app’s stored KPI thresholds and heuristics (e.g., flag low ROAS, high CAC, low conversion rate) with explanations and links to the relevant underlying data.

quotes:
7️⃣ Decision & Strategy Assistant
AI-powered recommendations like:
“Increase ad budget for Brand A”
“Reduce price of Product B”
“Improve homepage CTA”
Weekly action plan

acceptanceCriteria: Recommendations are generated deterministically from configured rules (no external AI/LLM calls).
Each recommendation includes a reason (which KPI/threshold triggered it) and the brand/campaign/SKU it relates to.
Weekly action plan can be generated on demand and saved for later review.

requirements.text: Reports & Presentations (MVP): implement weekly and monthly report generation per brand and cross-brand overview, with client-friendly layouts and export to PDF from the frontend.

quotes:
8️⃣ Reports & Presentations
Auto-generate:
Weekly reports
Monthly reviews
Client presentations
Export to PDF / PPT

acceptanceCriteria: User can generate a Weekly and Monthly report view with key KPIs, charts, and notable changes.
User can export the report to a PDF file.
Exported PDF contains readable typography and includes date range + brand(s).

requirements.text: Task & Workflow Manager: implement daily to-do list with priority tagging, due dates, reminders (in-app), and collaboration notes attached to brands or tasks.

quotes:
9️⃣ Task & Workflow Manager
Daily to-do list
Priority tagging
Follow-up reminders
Team collaboration notes

acceptanceCriteria: User can create/edit/complete tasks and filter by brand, status, due date, and priority.
Tasks support freeform notes and optional association to a brand.
Reminders appear as in-app indicators for due/overdue tasks.

requirements.text: Learning & Growth Section: implement a knowledge repository with categories (best practices, case studies, playbooks, personal notes), searchable entries, and per-entry rich text (basic formatting) and attachments as links.

quotes:
10️⃣ Learning & Growth Section
Store best practices
Case studies
Playbooks for scaling brands
My personal notes

acceptanceCriteria: User can create/edit/view knowledge entries by category.
User can search entries by title and body text.
Entries persist and are scoped by access permissions (RBAC).

requirements.text: Create and commit project documentation describing (a) system architecture, (b) UI flow, (c) Motoko data model/storage layout, and (d) an MVP roadmap with phases and clear scope boundaries aligned to the requested modules.

quotes: Please design the full system architecture, UI flow, database structure, and MVP roadmap for this app.

acceptanceCriteria: Docs include a page/section for architecture (frontend/back-end responsibilities, data flow).
Docs include UI flow/navigation map and primary user journeys (e.g., add brand → add KPIs → dashboard → report).
Docs include a database/data model section listing the core entities and relationships.
Docs include an MVP roadmap phased into at least 2 stages (MVP now vs. later), explicitly calling out deferred items (e.g., live API integrations, PPT export).

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive, clean visual theme (not blue/purple) across the app: define a neutral analytics-style palette (e.g., charcoal, off-white, sage/teal accent), consistent typography scale, and reusable layouts for tables, metrics cards, and charts.

quotes:
Technical Requirements:
Simple, clean UI
Mobile-friendly

acceptanceCriteria: All main pages share consistent spacing, typography, and component styling.
Theme is applied consistently to navigation, headings, cards, tables, and empty states.
Design remains accessible (reasonable contrast, readable text on mobile).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not create or modify backend/migration.mo unless an upgrade/migration is required later.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
Authentication must use Internet Identity only (no third-party auth providers).
No external databases; persist data in canister stable storage.
nonGoals: Implement live API integrations for Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, or logistics providers in MVP (provide manual entry/import-friendly structures instead).
Implement true AI/LLM-powered recommendations (use rule-based heuristics only).
Real-time collaboration/chat, push notifications, email/SMS reminders.
PPT export in MVP (PDF export only).

goalsToAdd: Build a centralized growth management dashboard to manage and optimize multiple D2C brands across performance, marketing, CRO, product, operations, reporting, tasks, and knowledge management.
preferencesToAdd: Prefer a simple, clean, mobile-friendly UI with secure login and role-based access.
miscToAdd: User is a Growth Lead at ShopDeck managing 15+ D2C brands; responsibilities include ads optimization (Meta/Google), conversion optimization, product/category management, shipping/ops tracking, and reporting.
